units.zh: 太祖耶律阿保機上
units.en: Annals of Taizu Yelü Abaoji, Part One
units.literal: Taizu Yelü Abaoji, Part One

units.zh: 太祖大聖大明神烈天皇帝，姓耶律氏，諱億，字阿保機，小字啜里只，契丹迭剌部霞瀨益石烈鄉耶律彌里人。
units.en: Taizu, styled the Great Sage and Bright Divine Martial Heavenly Emperor, bore the surname Yelü; his given name was Yi, his courtesy name Abaoji, and his childhood name Chuilizhi. He came from Yelü Mili in the Xiasiyishi Lie of the Khitan Diela branch.
units.literal: The Taizu, Great Sage, Great Brightness, Divine Martial, Heavenly Emperor — surname Yelü, taboo name Yi, courtesy name Abaoji, childhood name Chuilizhi — was a native of Yelü Mili village, Xiasiyishi Lie, Diela Department of the Khitan.

units.zh: 德祖皇帝長子，母曰宣簡皇后蕭氏。
units.en: He was the eldest son of Emperor Dezu, born to Empress Xuanjian of the Xiao clan.
units.literal: He was the eldest son of Emperor Dezu; his mother was Empress Xuanjian, née Xiao.

units.zh: 唐咸通十三年生。
units.en: He was born in the thirteenth year of Emperor Yizong's Xiantong era (872).
units.literal: He was born in the thirteenth year of the Tang Xiantong reign.

units.zh: 初，母夢日墮懷中，有娠。
units.en: Before his birth, his mother dreamed that the sun dropped into her breast, and afterward she became pregnant.
units.literal: At the beginning, his mother dreamed that the sun fell into her bosom, and she conceived.

units.zh: 及生，室有神光異香，體如三歲兒，即能匍匐。
units.en: At his birth, divine light filled the room and a strange fragrance hung in the air. His body was already like a three-year-old's, and he could crawl immediately.
units.literal: When he was born, the room had divine light and strange fragrance; his body was like that of a three-year-old child, and he could crawl at once.

units.zh: 祖母簡獻皇后異之，鞠為己子。
units.en: His grandmother Empress Jianxian took him for a prodigy and raised him as if he were her own child.
units.literal: His grandmother, Empress Jianxian, regarded him as extraordinary and reared him as her own son.

units.zh: 常匿於別幕，塗其面，不令他人見。
units.en: She kept him hidden in a separate tent, darkened his face with ash, and forbade anyone else to look upon him.
units.literal: She often hid him in a separate tent, smeared his face, and did not allow others to see him.

units.zh: 三月能行；
units.en: By three months he could walk;
units.literal: At three months he could walk;

units.zh: 而能言，知未然事。
units.en: and soon he could speak and foretell events yet to come.
units.literal: and he could speak, and knew things before they happened.

units.zh: 自謂左右若有神人翼衛。
units.en: He said that divine guardians seemed to hover at his sides, winged and vigilant.
units.literal: He claimed that on his left and right there seemed to be divine beings guarding him with wings.

units.zh: 雖齠齔，言必及世務。
units.en: Even as a child with baby teeth, he spoke always of public affairs.
units.literal: Although he was still in childhood, his words always touched upon affairs of state.

units.zh: 時伯父當國，疑輒咨焉。
units.en: His uncle then governed the Khitan, and whenever uncertain he sought the boy's counsel.
units.literal: At that time his uncle held power over the state; whenever in doubt he would consult him.

units.zh: 既長，身長九尺，豐上銳下，目光射人，關弓三百斤。
units.en: Grown to manhood, he stood nine chi in height — broad-shouldered above, lean below — with a gaze that struck men like an arrow and strength enough to draw a three-hundred-jin bow.
units.literal: When he had grown up, he stood nine chi tall, broad above and tapering below; his gaze pierced people, and he could draw a bow of three hundred jin.

units.zh: 為撻馬狘沙里。
units.en: He held the office of tamagh boshuli.
units.literal: He served as tamagh boshuli.

units.zh: 時小黃室韋不附，太祖以計降之。
units.en: When the Lesser Yellow Shiwei refused submission, Taizu took them by strategy.
units.literal: At that time the Lesser Yellow Shiwei did not submit; Taizu subdued them by stratagem.

units.zh: 伐越兀及烏古、六奚、比沙諸部，克之。
units.en: He marched against Yuewu and the Wugu, Liuxi, and Bisha tribes, among others, and brought them to heel.
units.literal: He attacked the Yuewu, Wugu, Liuxi, Bisha, and other tribes, and conquered them.

units.zh: 國人號阿主沙裏。
units.en: His countrymen gave him the name Azhu Shar.
units.literal: The people of the state called him Azhu Shar.

units.zh: 唐天復元年，歲辛酉，痕德可汗立，以太祖為本部夷離，專征討，連破室韋、于厥及奚帥轄剌哥，俘獲甚眾。
units.en: In the first year of the Tang Tianfu era (901), the xinyou year, Hende Khan came to power and made Taizu yilijin of his own branch, entrusting him with military command. Taizu in succession broke the Shiwei and Yujue and the Xi leader Xialage, taking vast numbers captive.
units.literal: In the first year of the Tang Tianfu reign, the year xinyou, Hende Khan was enthroned and appointed Taizu yilijin of the native tribe, put in charge of campaigns; he repeatedly defeated the Shiwei, Yujue, and the Xi chieftain Xialage, capturing many prisoners.

units.zh: 冬十月，授大迭烈府夷離。
units.en: That winter, in the tenth month, he was given the post of yilijin of the Great Diela Prefecture.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, he was appointed yilijin of the Great Diela Prefecture.

units.zh: 明年秋七月，以兵四十萬伐河東代北，<二>攻下九郡，獲生口九萬五千，駝、馬、牛、羊不可勝紀。
units.en: The next autumn, in the seventh month, he led four hundred thousand men against Hedong and northern Dai, <2> seized nine commanderies, took ninety-five thousand captives, and won camels, horses, cattle, and sheep past all count.
units.literal: The following year, in the seventh month of autumn, with four hundred thousand troops he attacked Hedong and the north of Dai; <2> he captured nine commanderies, taking ninety-five thousand captives, and camels, horses, cattle, and sheep beyond numbering.

units.zh: 九月，城龍化州於潢河之南，始建開教寺。
units.en: In the ninth month he fortified Longhua Prefecture on the south bank of the Huang River and founded Kaijiao Temple.
units.literal: In the ninth month, he walled Longhua Prefecture south of the Huang River and for the first time built Kaijiao Temple.

units.zh: 明年春，伐女直，下之，獲其戶三百。
units.en: The next spring he campaigned against the Jurchen, brought them down, and took three hundred households.
units.literal: The following spring, he attacked the Jurchen, subjugated them, and captured three hundred households.

units.zh: 九月，復攻下河東懷遠等軍。
units.en: In the ninth month he renewed the assault on Hedong and took the Huaiyuan garrison and others.
units.literal: In the ninth month, he again attacked and captured the Huaiyuan Army and other Hedong garrisons.

units.zh: 冬十月，引軍略至薊北，俘獲以還。
units.en: That winter, in the tenth month, he pushed his forces in a foray to the north of Ji and returned laden with prisoners and plunder.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, he led his army in a raid as far as north of Ji and returned with captives and booty.

units.zh: 先是德祖俘奚七千戶，徙饒樂之清河，至是創為奚迭剌部，分十三縣。
units.en: Earlier Dezu had taken seven thousand Xi households and resettled them at Qinghe in Raole; now they were organized into the Xi Diela branch, divided into thirteen counties.
units.literal: Previously Dezu had captured seven thousand Xi households and moved them to Qinghe in Raole; at this time they were established as the Xi Diela branch and divided into thirteen districts.

units.zh: 遂拜太祖于越、總知軍國事。
units.en: Taizu was thereupon made yue, with full authority over army and state.
units.literal: Taizu was then appointed yue and given overall charge of military and state affairs.

units.zh: 明年歲甲子，三月，廣龍化州之東城。
units.en: The next year, a jiazi year, in the third month the eastern quarter of Longhua Prefecture was enlarged.
units.literal: The following year, the jiazi year, in the third month, the eastern wall of Longhua Prefecture was expanded.

units.zh: 九月，討黑車子室韋，唐盧龍軍節度使劉仁恭發兵數萬，遣養子趙霸來拒。
units.en: In the ninth month he marched against the Black-Cart Shiwei. Liu Rengong, Tang governor of the Lulong Army, raised tens of thousands of men and sent his adopted son Zhao Ba to meet him.
units.literal: In the ninth month, he campaigned against the Black-Cart Shiwei; Liu Rengong, Military Governor of the Tang Lulong Army, sent tens of thousands of troops and dispatched his adopted son Zhao Ba to resist.

units.zh: 霸至武州，太祖諜知之，伏勁兵桃山下。
units.en: Ba reached Wuzhou; Taizu, warned by his scouts, lay in wait with elite troops beneath Peach Mountain.
units.literal: When Ba reached Wuzhou, Taizu learned of it through spies and hid crack troops below Peach Mountain.

units.zh: 遣室韋人牟裏詐稱其酋長所遣，約霸兵會平原。
units.en: He sent a Shiwei named Moli to pose as an envoy from the chieftain and invite Ba's army to a rendezvous on the open plain.
units.literal: He sent a Shiwei man named Moli, who falsely claimed to have been sent by his chieftain, to arrange a meeting with Ba's forces on the plain.

units.zh: 既至，四面伏發，擒霸，殲其眾，乘勝大破室韋。
units.en: When Ba came, ambushers rose on every side. They took Ba prisoner, wiped out his army, and drove on to shatter the Shiwei.
units.literal: When they arrived, the hidden troops sprang up on all sides; they captured Ba, annihilated his force, and pressing the victory routed the Shiwei.

units.zh: 明年七月，復討黑車子室韋。
units.en: The next year, in the seventh month, he returned to punish the Black-Cart Shiwei.
units.literal: The following year, in the seventh month, he again campaigned against the Black-Cart Shiwei.

units.zh: 唐河東節度使李克用遣通事康令德乞盟。
units.en: Li Keyong, Tang's Hedong governor, sent his interpreter Kang Lingde to sue for an alliance.
units.literal: Li Keyong, Military Governor of Hedong under the Tang, sent the interpreter Kang Lingde to request an alliance.

units.zh: 冬十月，太祖以騎兵七萬會克用於雲州，宴酣，克用借兵以報劉仁恭木瓜澗之役，太祖許之。
units.en: That winter, in the tenth month, Taizu brought seventy thousand horsemen to meet Keyong at Yunzhou. Over wine Keyong asked for troops to settle the score with Liu Rengong at Mugua Ravine, and Taizu consented.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Taizu with seventy thousand cavalry met Keyong at Yunzhou; when the banquet was well underway, Keyong asked to borrow troops to avenge his defeat by Liu Rengong at Mugua Ravine, and Taizu agreed.

units.zh: 易袍馬，約為兄弟。
units.en: They exchanged cloaks and mounts and swore themselves brothers.
units.literal: They exchanged robes and horses and pledged brotherhood.

units.zh: 及進兵擊仁恭，撥數州，盡徙其民以歸。
units.en: Marching on Rengong, they overran several prefectures and carried off the entire populace.
units.literal: When they advanced to attack Rengong, they seized several prefectures and moved all the people away with them.

units.zh: 明年二月，復擊劉仁恭。
units.en: The next year, in the second month, they struck Liu Rengong once more.
units.literal: The following year, in the second month, they again attacked Liu Rengong.

units.zh: 還，襲山北奚，破之。
units.en: On the homeward march they fell upon the mountain-north Xi and broke them.
units.literal: On the return, they raided the Xi north of the mountains and defeated them.

units.zh: 汴州朱全忠遣人浮海奉書幣、衣帶、珍玩來聘。
units.en: Zhu Quanzhong of Bianzhou dispatched envoys by sea with letters, tribute gifts, robes, sashes, and curiosities to propose alliance.
units.literal: Zhu Quanzhong of Bianzhou sent men by sea bearing letters, gifts, robes and belts, and precious objects to offer friendship.

units.zh: 十一月，遣偏師討奚、諸部及東北女直之未附者，悉破降之。
units.en: In the eleventh month he sent a subsidiary army against the Xi and allied tribes, and against Jurchen in the northeast still outside his sway; all were crushed and brought to surrender.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, he sent a detached force to campaign against the Xi and various tribes, and the unsubmitted Jurchen of the northeast; all were defeated and made to submit.

units.zh: 十二月，痕德可汗殂，群臣奉遺命請立太祖。
units.en: In the twelfth month Hende Khan died. The ministers, following his dying wish, pressed Taizu to take the throne.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Hende Khan died; the ministers, obeying his final command, asked that Taizu be enthroned.

units.zh: 曷魯等勸進。
units.en: Helu and others pressed him to ascend.
units.literal: Helu and others urged him to accept.

units.zh: 太祖三讓，從之。
units.en: Taizu refused thrice before yielding to them.
units.literal: Taizu declined three times, then acquiesced.

units.zh: 元年春正月庚寅，命有司設壇于如迂王集會堝，<三>燔柴告天，即皇帝位。
units.en: In his first year, on the gengyin day of the first spring month, he had officials erect an altar at the Ru'erwang Assembly Mound, <3> offered burnt sacrifices to Heaven, and ascended the throne.
units.literal: In the first year, on gengyin day in the first month of spring, he ordered officials to set up an altar at the Ru'erwang Assembly Mound; <3> he burned sacrificial wood to announce Heaven and took the imperial throne.

units.zh: 尊母蕭氏為皇太后，立皇后蕭氏。
units.en: He raised his mother of the Xiao clan to Empress Dowager and crowned an Empress Xiao.
units.literal: He honored his mother, née Xiao, as Empress Dowager and installed Empress Xiao.

units.zh: 北宰相蕭轄剌、南宰相耶律歐裏思率群臣上尊號曰天皇帝，後曰地皇后。
units.en: Northern Chancellor Xiao Xialage and Southern Chancellor Yelü Oulisi, at the head of the court, presented the elevated titles Heavenly Emperor for him and Earth Empress for her.
units.literal: The Northern Chancellor Xiao Xialage and the Southern Chancellor Yelü Oulisi led the ministers in offering the honorific titles Heavenly Emperor and Earth Empress.

units.zh: 庚子，詔皇族承遙輦氏九帳為第十帳。
units.en: On gengzi day he decreed that the royal house should take its place as a tenth tent, succeeding the nine tents of the Yaolian line.
units.literal: On gengzi day, an edict proclaimed that the imperial clan would succeed the nine tents of the Yaolian clan as the tenth tent.

units.zh: 二月戊午，以從弟迭栗底為迭烈府夷離。
units.en: On wuwu day of the second month he named his cousin Dielidi yilijin of the Diela Prefecture.
units.literal: On wuwu day in the second month, he appointed his younger cousin Dielidi yilijin of the Diela Prefecture.

units.zh: 是月，征黑車子室韋，降其八部。
units.en: That same month he marched on the Black-Cart Shiwei and received the submission of all eight of their tribes.
units.literal: That month, he campaigned against the Black-Cart Shiwei and brought their eight tribes to submission.

units.zh: 夏四月丁未朔，唐梁王朱全忠廢其主，尋弑之，<四>自立為帝，國號梁，遣使來告。
units.en: On the dingwei new moon of the fourth summer month, Zhu Quanzhong, Tang's Prince of Liang, deposed his lord and shortly afterward murdered him; <4> he proclaimed himself emperor under the name Liang and sent envoys with the news.
units.literal: On dingwei, the first day of the fourth month of summer, Zhu Quanzhong, Prince of Liang under the Tang, deposed his sovereign and soon killed him; <4> he declared himself emperor, taking the dynastic name Liang, and sent envoys to announce it.

units.zh: 劉仁恭子守光囚其父，自稱幽州盧龍軍節度使。
units.en: Liu Shouguang, son of Liu Rengong, locked up his father and declared himself governor of Youzhou and the Lulong Army.
units.literal: Liu Rengong's son Shouguang imprisoned his father and styled himself Military Governor of Youzhou and the Lulong Army.

units.zh: 秋七月乙酉，其兄平州刺史守奇率其眾數千人來降，命置之平盧城。
units.en: On yiyou day in the seventh autumn month his elder brother Shouqi, prefect of Pingzhou, came over with several thousand men and was resettled at Pinglu City.
units.literal: On yiyou day in the seventh month of autumn, his elder brother Shouqi, Governor of Pingzhou, led several thousand of his followers to surrender, and they were ordered settled at Pinglu City.

units.zh: 冬十月乙巳，討黑車子室韋，破之。
units.en: On yisi day that winter, in the tenth month, he attacked the Black-Cart Shiwei and broke them.
units.literal: On yisi day in the tenth month of winter, he campaigned against the Black-Cart Shiwei and defeated them.

units.zh: 二年春正月癸酉朔，禦正殿受百官及諸國使朝。
units.en: On the guiyou new moon of the second year's first spring month, he held court in the main hall to receive the obeisance of officials and foreign envoys.
units.literal: On guiyou, the first day of the first month of spring in the second year, he received homage in the main hall from officials and envoys of various states.

units.zh: 辛巳，始置惕隱，典族屬，以皇弟撒剌為之。
units.en: On xinsi day he created the office of tiyin to govern the clans and appointed his brother Salaci to the post.
units.literal: On xinsi day, the office of tiyin was first established to oversee clan affairs, and his imperial brother Salaci was appointed to it.

units.zh: 河東李克用卒，子存勗襲，遣使吊慰。
units.en: Li Keyong of Hedong died; his son Li Cunxu took his place, and Taizu sent envoys with condolences.
units.literal: Li Keyong of Hedong died; his son Li Cunxu succeeded him, and envoys were sent to offer condolences.

units.zh: 夏五月癸酉，詔撒剌討烏丸、黑車子室韋。
units.en: On guiyou day of the fifth summer month he commanded Salaci against the Wuhuan and the Black-Cart Shiwei.
units.literal: On guiyou day in the fifth month of summer, an edict ordered Salaci to campaign against the Wuhuan and Black-Cart Shiwei.

units.zh: 秋八月壬子，幽州進合歡瓜。
units.en: On renzi day in the eighth autumn month, Youzhou sent tribute of a twin-fused melon.
units.literal: On renzi day in the eighth month of autumn, Youzhou presented a hehuan melon.

units.zh: 冬十月己亥朔，建明王樓。
units.en: On the jihai new moon of the tenth winter month, he erected the Bright King Tower.
units.literal: On jihai, the first day of the tenth month of winter, the Bright King Tower was built.

units.zh: 築長城於鎮東海口。
units.en: He constructed a long wall at Zhendong's seaward mouth.
units.literal: A long wall was built at the eastern sea mouth of Zhen.

units.zh: 遣輕兵取吐渾叛入室韋者。
units.en: He sent light cavalry to seize Tuyuhun rebels who had crossed into Shiwei lands.
units.literal: Light troops were dispatched to capture Tuyuhun rebels who had fled into Shiwei territory.

units.zh: 三年春正月，幸遼東。
units.en: In the third year's first spring month he toured Liaodong.
units.literal: In the first month of spring in the third year, he visited Liaodong.

units.zh: 二月丁酉朔，梁遣郎公遠來聘。
units.en: On the dingyou new moon of the second month, Liang dispatched Lang Gongyuan as envoy.
units.literal: On dingyou, the first day of the second month, Liang sent Lang Gongyuan on a diplomatic mission.

units.zh: 三月，滄州節度使劉守文為弟守光所攻，遣人來乞兵討之。
units.en: In the third month Liu Shouwen, governor of Cangzhou, came under attack from his brother Shouguang and sent asking for troops to strike back.
units.literal: In the third month, Liu Shouwen, Military Governor of Cangzhou, was attacked by his brother Shouguang and sent men to request troops to campaign against him.

units.zh: 命皇弟舍利素、夷離蕭敵魯以兵會守文於北淖口。
units.en: He commanded his brother Sheli Su and the yilijin Xiao Dilu to march and rendezvous with Shouwen at Beinao Mouth.
units.literal: He ordered his imperial brother Sheli Su and the yilijin Xiao Dilu to lead troops to join Shouwen at Beinao Mouth.

units.zh: 進至橫海軍近澱，一鼓破之，守光潰去。
units.en: Pushing to the flats near the Henghai garrison, they shattered the foe at a single drumbeat and Shouguang broke and ran.
units.literal: Advancing to the marshland near the Henghai Army, they broke the enemy at the first assault and Shouguang fled in rout.

units.zh: 因名北淖口為會盟口。
units.en: Beinao Mouth was therefore renamed Alliance Mouth.
units.literal: Because of this, Beinao Mouth was renamed Alliance Mouth.

units.zh: 夏四月乙卯，詔左僕射韓知古建碑龍化州大廣寺以紀功德。
units.en: On yimao day of the fourth summer month he ordered Vice Premier Han Zhigu to raise a stele at Longhua Prefecture's Daguan Temple commemorating his achievements.
units.literal: On yimao day in the fourth month of summer, an edict ordered Left Vice Director Han Zhigu to erect a stele at the Daguan Temple of Longhua Prefecture to record meritorious deeds.

units.zh: 五月甲申，置羊城於炭山之北以通市易。
units.en: On jiashen day in the fifth month he founded a sheep market north of Coal Mountain for commerce.
units.literal: On jiashen day in the fifth month, a sheep market was established north of Coal Mountain to facilitate trade.

units.zh: 冬十月己巳，遣鷹軍討黑車子室韋，破之。
units.en: On jisi day that winter, in the tenth month, he sent the Hawk Army against the Black-Cart Shiwei and broke them.
units.literal: On jisi day in the tenth month of winter, the Hawk Army was sent to campaign against the Black-Cart Shiwei and defeated them.

units.zh: 西北娘改部族進挽車人。
units.en: The Nianggai tribe from the northwest offered cart-drivers in tribute.
units.literal: The Nianggai tribe of the northwest presented ox-cart drivers as tribute.

units.zh: 四年秋七月戊子朔，以后兄蕭敵魯為北府宰相。
units.en: On the wuzi new moon of the fourth year's seventh autumn month he named the Empress's elder brother Xiao Dilu Northern Chancellor.
units.literal: On wuzi, the first day of the seventh month of autumn in the fourth year, his empress's elder brother Xiao Dilu was appointed Northern Chancellor.

units.zh: 后族為相自此始。
units.en: Thus began the custom of appointing the Empress's kin as chancellor.
units.literal: From this time the empress's clan began to hold the chancellorship.

units.zh: 冬十月，烏馬山奚庫支及查剌底、鋤勃德等叛，討平之。
units.en: That winter, in the tenth month, the Wumashan Xi leaders Kuge, Chaladi, and Chubode rose in rebellion and were put down.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Xi chieftains Kuge, Chaladi, and Chubode of Wumashan rebelled and were suppressed.

units.zh: 五年春正月丙戌朔，日有食之。
units.en: On the bingxu new moon of the fifth year's first spring month the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: On bingxu, the first day of the first month of spring in the fifth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 丙申，上親征西部奚。
units.en: On bingshen day the Emperor took the field in person against the western Xi.
units.literal: On bingshen day, the Emperor personally campaigned against the western Xi.

units.zh: 奚阻險，叛服不常，數招諭弗聽。
units.en: The Xi barricaded themselves in rugged country, wavering between rebellion and submission; repeated appeals brought no answer.
units.literal: The Xi held difficult terrain; their submission and rebellion were inconstant, and repeated summons and persuasion went unheeded.

units.zh: 是役所向輒下，遂分兵討東部奚，亦平之。
units.en: In that campaign he took every stronghold he met; he then split his army to subdue the eastern Xi and pacified them too.
units.literal: In this campaign wherever he went he prevailed; he then divided his forces to campaign against the eastern Xi and pacified them as well.

units.zh: 於是盡有奚、霫之地。
units.en: He now held the full territory of the Xi and Mohe.
units.literal: Thus he came to possess all the lands of the Xi and Mohe.

units.zh: 東際海，南暨白檀，西松漠，北抵潢水，凡五部，咸入版籍。
units.en: Eastward it ran to the sea, south to Baitan, west to Songmo, north to the Huang River — five divisions in all, every one entered on the tax rolls.
units.literal: It reached the sea on the east, touched Baitan on the south, Songmo on the west, and the Huang River on the north; all five divisions were entered on the registers.

units.zh: 三月，次灤河，刻石紀功。
units.en: In the third month he encamped on the Luan River and cut stone inscriptions to commemorate his victories.
units.literal: In the third month, he halted at the Luan River and carved stone to record his achievements.

units.zh: 復略地薊州。
units.en: He again carried out a raid into Jizhou.
units.literal: He again raided the territory of Jizhou.

units.zh: 夏四月壬申，遣人使梁。
units.en: On renshen day of the fourth summer month he dispatched envoys to Liang.
units.literal: On renshen day in the fourth month of summer, envoys were sent to Liang.

units.zh: 五月，皇弟剌葛、迭剌、寅底石、安端謀反。
units.en: In the fifth month his brothers Cige, Diela, Yindishi, and Anduan conspired to rebel.
units.literal: In the fifth month, his imperial brothers Cige, Diela, Yindishi, and Anduan plotted rebellion.

units.zh: 安端妻粘睦姑知之，以告，得實。
units.en: Anduan's wife Nianmugu discovered the plot, informed the court, and the charge was proved true.
units.literal: Anduan's wife Nianmugu learned of it, reported it, and the plot was verified.

units.zh: 上不忍加誅，乃與諸弟登山刑牲，告天地為誓而赦其罪。
units.en: Unable to bring himself to punish them, he climbed a mountain with his brothers, offered sacrifice, swore before Heaven and Earth, and granted them pardon.
units.literal: The Emperor could not bear to execute them; he therefore climbed a mountain with his brothers, sacrificed animals, announced Heaven and Earth as witnesses to an oath, and pardoned their crime.

units.zh: 出剌葛為迭剌部夷離，封粘睦姑為晉國夫人。
units.en: He posted Cige as yilijin of the Diela branch and ennobled Nianmugu as Lady of Jin.
units.literal: Cige was sent out as yilijin of the Diela branch, and Nianmugu was enfeoffed as Lady of Jin.

units.zh: 秋七月壬午朔，斜離底及諸蕃使來貢。
units.en: On the renwu new moon of the seventh autumn month, Xielidi and tribal envoys arrived with tribute.
units.literal: On renwu, the first day of the seventh month of autumn, Xielidi and envoys of various tribes came to offer tribute.

units.zh: 八月甲子，劉守光僭號幽州，稱燕。
units.en: On jiazi day in the eighth month Liu Shouguang seized the imperial style at Youzhou and proclaimed the state of Yan.
units.literal: On jiazi day in the eighth month, Liu Shouguang usurped title at Youzhou and styled himself Yan.

units.zh: 冬十月戊午，置鐵冶。
units.en: On wuwu day that winter, in the tenth month, he established an iron foundry.
units.literal: On wuwu day in the tenth month of winter, an iron foundry was established.

units.zh: 十一月壬午，遣人使梁。
units.en: On renwu day in the eleventh month he again sent envoys to Liang.
units.literal: On renwu day in the eleventh month, envoys were sent to Liang.

units.zh: 六年春正月，以化葛為惕隱。
units.en: In the sixth year's first spring month he made Huage tiyin.
units.literal: In the first month of spring in the sixth year, Huage was appointed tiyin.

units.zh: 二月戊午，親征劉守光。
units.en: On wuwu day of the second month he took the field in person against Liu Shouguang.
units.literal: On wuwu day in the second month, he personally campaigned against Liu Shouguang.

units.zh: 三月，至自幽州。
units.en: In the third month he came back from Youzhou.
units.literal: In the third month, he returned from Youzhou.

units.zh: 夏四月，梁郢王友弑父自立。
units.en: In the fourth summer month Zhu Yougui, Liang's Prince of Ying, murdered his father and seized the throne.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, You, Prince of Ying of Liang, killed his father and declared himself ruler.

units.zh: 秋七月丙午，親征術不姑，降之，俘獲以數萬計。
units.en: On bingwu day in the seventh autumn month he marched in person against Shibugu, received their surrender, and took prisoners and spoil by the tens of thousands.
units.literal: On bingwu day in the seventh month of autumn, he personally campaigned against Shibugu, made them submit, and took captives and booty numbering in the tens of thousands.

units.zh: 命弟剌葛分兵攻平州。
units.en: He commanded his brother Cige to split off troops and strike Pingzhou.
units.literal: He ordered his brother Cige to divide forces and attack Pingzhou.

units.zh: 八月壬辰，上次恩德山。
units.en: On renchen day in the eighth month he encamped on Mount Ende.
units.literal: On renchen day in the eighth month, the Emperor halted at Mount Ende.

units.zh: 皇子李胡生。
units.en: The prince Li Hu was born.
units.literal: The Prince Li Hu was born.

units.zh: 冬十月戊寅，剌葛破平州，還，復與迭剌、寅底石、安端等反。
units.en: In the tenth winter month, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Diela, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on wuyin day, Cige captured Pingzhou and returned, then rebelled again with Diela, Yindishi, Anduan, and others.

units.zh: 甲申，遣人使梁致祭。
units.en: On jiashen day he dispatched envoys to the Liang court to offer sacrifice.
units.literal: On jiashen day, he sent envoys to Liang to perform sacrifice.

units.zh: 壬辰，還次北阿魯山，聞諸弟以兵阻道，引軍南趨十七濼。
units.en: On renchen day, as he withdrew and encamped at North Alu Mountain, he learned that his younger brothers had barred the route with troops, and he turned the army south toward the Seventeen Marshes.
units.literal: On renchen day, returning he halted at North Alu Mountain; hearing his younger brothers had blocked the road with troops, he led the army south toward the Seventeen Marshes.

units.zh: 是日燔柴。
units.en: That day he performed the firewood-burning rite.
units.literal: That day they burned firewood.

units.zh: 翼日，次七渡河，諸弟各遣人謝罪。
units.en: The following day he halted at Seven Crossings River, and each of his younger brothers sent a messenger to beg forgiveness.
units.literal: The next day, halting at Seven Crossings River, each younger brother sent someone to apologize.

units.zh: 上猶矜憐，許以自新。
units.en: The Emperor still showed them mercy and granted them a chance to mend their ways.
units.literal: The Emperor still showed pity and allowed them to reform themselves.

units.zh: 是歲，以兵討兩冶，以所獲僧崇文等五十人歸西樓，建天雄寺以居之，以示天助雄武。
units.en: That year he campaigned against Liangye with an army, brought fifty captives including the monk Chongwen back to Xilou, and built Tianxiong Temple to lodge them, as a sign that Heaven favored his martial power.
units.literal: That year, with troops he attacked Liangye; he brought back fifty captives including the monk Chongwen to Xilou, built Tianxiong Temple to house them, to show Heaven aiding martial prowess.

units.zh: 七年春正月甲辰朔，以用兵免朝。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the seventh year, on the jiachen new moon, the court audience was waived because of active campaigning.
units.literal: In spring of the seventh year, on the jiachen new moon of the first month, court audience was exempted because of military operations.

units.zh: 晉王李存勗拔幽州，擒劉守光。
units.en: Li Cunxu, Prince of Jin, marched on Youzhou and took Liu Shouguang prisoner.
units.literal: The Prince of Jin, Li Cunxu, attacked Youzhou and captured Liu Shouguang.

units.zh: 甲寅，王師次赤水城，弟剌葛等乞降。
units.en: On jiayin day the imperial forces encamped at Chishui Fort, and his younger brothers Cige and the others pleaded to submit.
units.literal: On jiayin day, the imperial army halted at Chishui Fort; the younger brothers Cige and others begged to surrender.

units.zh: 上素服，乘赭白馬，以將軍耶律樂姑、轄剌僅阿缽為禦，解兵器、肅侍衛以受之，因加慰諭。
units.en: The Emperor dressed in plain white and rode a reddish-white horse, with Generals Yelü Legu and Xiachi Jin'abo as his escort; he set aside his weapons, had his attendants stand in strict order to receive them, and then spoke words of reassurance.
units.literal: The Emperor wore plain white garments, rode a reddish-white horse, with Generals Yelü Legu and Xiachi Jin'abo as escort; he laid aside weapons and ordered the guards to stand in order to receive them, and thereupon added words of consolation.

units.zh: 剌葛等引退，上復數遣使撫慰。
units.en: Cige and the others withdrew, and the Emperor again sent envoys repeatedly to comfort them.
units.literal: Cige and the others withdrew; the Emperor again sent envoys several times to console them.

units.zh: 二月甲戌朔，梁均王友貞討殺其兄友，嗣立。
units.en: On the jiaxu new moon of the second month, Zhu Youzhen, Liang's Prince of Jun, struck down his elder brother Zhu You and seized the throne.
units.literal: On the jiaxu new moon of the second month, Youzhen, Prince of Jun of Liang, attacked and killed his elder brother You, and succeeded to the throne.

units.zh: 三月癸丑，次蘆水，弟迭剌哥圖為奚王，與安端擁千餘騎而至，紿稱入覲。
units.en: On guichou day in the third month he halted at Lushui. His younger brother Diela plotted to become King of Xi and, together with Anduan at the head of more than a thousand horsemen, arrived, falsely claiming they had come to attend court.
units.literal: On guichou day in the third month, halting at Lushui, his younger brother Diela plotted to become King of Xi and arrived with Anduan leading more than a thousand horsemen, falsely claiming they had come to pay court.

units.zh: 上怒曰：「爾曹始謀逆亂，朕特恕之，使改過自新，尚爾反覆，將不利於朕！」
units.en: The Emperor said in anger, "You first plotted rebellion; I specially forgave you and let you reform, yet you are still so fickle—this can only mean harm to me!"
units.literal: The Emperor said in anger: "You at first plotted rebellion; I especially pardoned you and let you reform yourselves, yet you are still so changeable—this will be harmful to me!"

units.zh: 遂拘之。
units.en: He thereupon had them seized.
units.literal: Thereupon he detained them.

units.zh: 以所部分隸諸軍。
units.en: Their followers were distributed among the various armies.
units.literal: Their detachments were assigned to the various armies.

units.zh: 而剌葛引其眾至乙室堇澱，具天子旗鼓，將自立，皇太后陰遣人諭令避去。
units.en: Meanwhile Cige led his forces to Yishijin Marsh, arrayed the imperial drums and banners, and was about to set himself up as ruler; the Empress Dowager secretly sent word telling him to withdraw.
units.literal: Meanwhile Cige led his host to Yishijin Marsh, equipped with the imperial drums and banners, intending to declare himself ruler; the Empress Dowager secretly sent someone to instruct him to withdraw.

units.zh: 會弭姑乃、懷裏陽言車駕且至，其眾驚潰，掠居民北走，上以兵追之。
units.en: Just then Migunai and Huailiyang spread word that the imperial carriage was nearing; Cige's men broke in panic, looted the local people, and fled north, and the Emperor gave chase with troops.
units.literal: At that time Migunai and Huailiyang said the imperial carriage was about to arrive; his host panicked and scattered, plundered the inhabitants, and fled north; the Emperor pursued with troops.

units.zh: 剌葛遣其党寅底石引兵徑趨行宮，焚其輜重、廬帳，縱兵大殺。
units.en: Cige sent his follower Yindishi to march straight on the traveling palace, burn the baggage train and tents, and unleash his troops in a great slaughter.
units.literal: Cige sent his partisan Yindishi to lead troops straight to the traveling palace, burn the baggage train and tents, and let the soldiers slaughter widely.

units.zh: 皇后急遣蜀古魯救之，<六>僅得天子旗鼓而已。
units.en: The Empress urgently dispatched Shugulu to the rescue; <6> they recovered nothing but the imperial drums and banners.
units.literal: The Empress urgently sent Shugulu to rescue them; <6> they recovered only the imperial drums and banners.

units.zh: 其党神速姑復劫西樓，焚明王樓。
units.en: His follower Shensugun raided Xilou again and burned Mingwang Tower.
units.literal: His partisan Shensugun again raided Xilou and burned Mingwang Tower.

units.zh: 上至土河，秣馬休兵，若不為意。
units.en: When the Emperor reached the Tuh River, he let the horses graze and rested the army as though none of this troubled him.
units.literal: The Emperor reached the Tuh River, fed the horses and rested the troops, as if unconcerned.

units.zh: 諸將請急追之，上曰：「俟其遠遁，人各懷土。
units.en: The generals urged an immediate pursuit, but the Emperor said, "Wait until they have fled far off; then each man will yearn for home.
units.literal: The generals asked to pursue them urgently; the Emperor said: "Wait until they have fled far—each man will long for home.

units.zh: 懷土既切，其心必離，我軍乘之，破之必矣！」
units.en: Once homesickness bites deep, their hearts will surely break apart; if our army strikes then, we are certain to crush them!"
units.literal: Once longing for home is keen, their hearts will surely split apart; our army will strike them and defeat them for certain!"

units.zh: 盡以先所獲資畜分賜將士，留夷離畢直裏姑總政務。
units.en: He distributed all the livestock and goods taken earlier among the officers and soldiers, and left the yilijin Zhiligu to oversee affairs of state.
units.literal: He distributed all the livestock and goods seized earlier among the officers and soldiers, and left the yilijin Zhiligu in charge of government affairs.

units.zh: 夏四月戊寅，北追剌葛。
units.en: In the fourth summer month, on wuyin day, he marched north in pursuit of Cige.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on wuyin day, he pursued Cige northward.

units.zh: 己卯，次弭裏，問諸弟面木葉山射鬼箭厭禳，<七>乃執叛人解裏向彼，亦以其法厭之。
units.en: On jimao day he halted at Mili and questioned his younger brothers before Mount Muye about the ghost-arrow shooting used for exorcism; <7> he then seized the rebel Jieli and turned him toward the mountain, exorcising him by the same rite.
units.literal: On jimao day, halting at Mili, he questioned the younger brothers before Mount Muye about shooting ghost-arrows for exorcism; <7> he then seized the rebel Jieli and turned him toward it, and likewise exorcised him by that method.

units.zh: 至達裏澱，選輕騎追及培只河，盡獲其黨輜重、生口。
units.en: At Dali Marsh he chose light cavalry and pursued as far as Peizhi River, taking all the rebels' baggage and captives.
units.literal: Reaching Dali Marsh, he selected light cavalry and pursued as far as Peizhi River, capturing all their partisans' baggage and captives.

units.zh: 先遣室韋及吐渾酋長撥剌、迪裏姑等五人分兵伏其前路，命北宰相迪裏古為先鋒進擊之。
units.en: He had already sent the Shivei and Tuhun chiefs Bala, Diligu, and three others to split their forces and lie in wait along the rebels' line of retreat, and he ordered the northern chancellor Diligu to advance as vanguard and strike them.
units.literal: He had first sent the Shivei and Tuhun chieftains Bala, Diligu, and three others to divide troops and lie in ambush on their route ahead, and ordered the Northern Chancellor Diligu to advance as vanguard and attack them.

units.zh: 剌葛率兵逆戰，迪裏古以輕兵薄之。
units.en: Cige led his troops out to give battle, and Diligu harried him with light forces.
units.literal: Cige led troops to meet them in battle; Diligu pressed him with light forces.

units.zh: 其弟遏古只臨陣，射數十人斃，眾莫敢前。
units.en: His younger brother Eguzhi took the front of the line, brought down several dozen men with his bow, and none dared press forward.
units.literal: His younger brother Eguzhi faced the battle line, shot down several tens of men, and none dared advance.

units.zh: 相拒至晡，眾乃潰。
units.en: The two sides held each other until late afternoon, and then Cige's men collapsed.
units.literal: They faced each other until the hour of shen, and then the host broke.

units.zh: 追至柴河，遂自焚其車乘廬帳而去。
units.en: Pursued to Chai River, they burned their carts, wagons, and tents and fled.
units.literal: Pursued to Chai River, they thereupon burned their carts, wagons, and tents and fled.

units.zh: 前遇拔剌、迪里姑等伏發，合擊，遂大敗之。
units.en: Farther on they ran into the ambush laid by Bala, Diligu, and the others; the combined attack left them utterly broken.
units.literal: Ahead they met the ambush sprung by Bala, Diligu, and the others; joining in the attack, they were utterly defeated.

units.zh: 剌葛奔潰，遺其所奪神帳於路，上見而拜奠之。
units.en: Cige fled in disorder, abandoning on the road the sacred tent he had seized; when the Emperor came upon it, he bowed and made offering.
units.literal: Cige fled in rout, leaving on the road the sacred tent he had seized; the Emperor saw it and bowed in offering.

units.zh: 所獲生口盡縱歸本土。
units.en: All captives taken were released to return home.
units.literal: All captives taken were released to return to their native lands.

units.zh: 其党庫古只、磨朵皆面縛請罪。
units.en: His followers Kuguzhi and Moduo came forward with their hands bound to plead guilty.
units.literal: His partisans Kuguzhi and Moduo all came forward with their hands bound to beg forgiveness.

units.zh: 師次劄堵河，大雨暴漲。
units.en: The army halted at Zhadu River, where torrential rain sent the waters surging.
units.literal: The army halted at Zhadu River; great rain swelled it violently.

units.zh: 五月癸丑，遣北宰相迪輦率驍騎先渡。
units.en: On guichou day in the fifth month he sent the northern chancellor Dilian ahead with elite cavalry to cross first.
units.literal: On guichou day in the fifth month, he sent the Northern Chancellor Dilian to lead crack horsemen across first.

units.zh: 甲寅，奏擒剌葛、涅裏袞阿缽於榆河，前北宰相蕭實魯、寅底石自剄不殊。
units.en: On jiayin day came word that Cige and Nieligun'abo had been taken at Yu River; the former northern chancellor Xiao Shilu and Yindishi slashed their own throats but did not die.
units.literal: On jiayin day, it was reported that Cige and Nieligun'abo had been captured at Yu River; the former Northern Chancellor Xiao Shilu and Yindishi cut their own throats without dying.

units.zh: 遂以黑白羊祭天地。
units.en: He then sacrificed black and white sheep to Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: Thereupon black and white sheep were offered in sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

units.zh: 壬戌，剌葛、涅裏袞阿缽詣行在，以稿索自縛，牽羊望拜。
units.en: On renxu day Cige and Nieligun'abo came to the traveling court, bound themselves with straw ropes, led sheep before them, and bowed from afar.
units.literal: On renxu day, Cige and Nieligun'abo came to the traveling court, bound themselves with straw ropes, led sheep, and bowed from afar.

units.zh: 上還至大嶺。
units.en: The Emperor withdrew to Great Ridge.
units.literal: The Emperor returned to Great Ridge.

units.zh: 時大軍久出，輜重不相屬，士卒煮馬駒、采野菜以為食，孳畜道斃者十七八，物價十倍，器服資貨委棄於楚裏河，狼藉數百里，因更剌葛名暴裏。
units.en: The great army had been in the field a long time; the baggage trains could not keep pace; the soldiers boiled foals and gathered wild greens to eat; seven or eight out of ten head of livestock died along the road; prices rose tenfold; arms, clothing, goods, and valuables were cast away along the Chuli River and lay strewn for hundreds of li; for this Cige's name was changed to Baoli.
units.literal: At that time the great army had been long abroad; baggage trains did not keep up; soldiers boiled foals and gathered wild vegetables for food; livestock dying on the road were seven or eight in ten; prices rose tenfold; weapons, garments, goods, and valuables were abandoned along the Chuli River, scattered for several hundred li; therefore Cige's name was changed to Baoli.

units.zh: 丙寅，至庫裏，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On bingyin day, reaching Kuli, he sacrificed blue oxen and white horses to Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: On bingyin day, reaching Kuli, he offered blue oxen and white horses in sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

units.zh: 以生口六百、馬二千三百分賜大、小鶻軍。
units.en: Six hundred captives and twenty-three hundred horses were distributed as rewards to the Greater and Lesser Gu armies.
units.literal: Six hundred captives and twenty-three hundred horses were distributed as gifts to the Greater and Lesser Gu Armies.

units.zh: 六月辛巳，至榆嶺，以轄賴縣人掃古非法殘民，磔之。
units.en: On xinsi day in the sixth month, at Yu Ridge, Saogu of Xialai County was torn apart for unlawfully oppressing the people.
units.literal: On xinsi day in the sixth month, reaching Yu Ridge, because the man Saogu of Xialai County had illegally harmed the people, he was dismembered.

units.zh: 甲申，上登都庵山，撫其先奇首可汗遺跡，徘徊顧瞻而興歎焉。
units.en: On jiashen day the Emperor climbed Mount Du'an, touched the traces left by the former Qishou Khan, and as he paced and looked about was moved to sigh.
units.literal: On jiashen day, the Emperor ascended Mount Du'an, stroked the traces left by the former Qishou Khan, and pacing back and forth gazing about, was moved to sigh.

units.zh: 聞獄官涅離擅造大校，人不堪其苦，有至死者，命誅之。
units.en: Learning that the prison official Nieli had on his own authority imposed the great cudgel, so that people could not endure the suffering and some even died, he ordered Nieli put to death.
units.literal: Hearing that the prison official Nieli had on his own authority imposed the great cudgel, and people could not bear the suffering, some even dying, he ordered him executed.

units.zh: 壬辰，次狼河，獲逆黨雅里、彌里，生埋之銅河南軌下。
units.en: On renchen day, encamped at Wolf River, he captured the rebels Yali and Mili and buried them alive beneath the track south of the Tong River.
units.literal: On renchen day, halting at Wolf River, he captured the rebels Yali and Mili and buried them alive beneath the track south of the Tong River.

units.zh: 放所俘還，多為于骨里所掠。
units.en: Captives who had been released to go home were largely seized again by the Yuguli.
units.literal: Captives who had been released to return were largely seized again by the Yuguli.

units.zh: 上怒，引輕騎馳擊。
units.en: The Emperor flew into a rage and led light cavalry in a swift strike.
units.literal: The Emperor was angry and led light cavalry in a swift attack.

units.zh: 復遣驍將分道追襲，盡獲其眾並掠者。
units.en: He again sent crack generals along separate routes in pursuit and recovered all their men along with the plunderers.
units.literal: He again sent crack generals to pursue along separate routes and captured all their host together with those who had plundered.

units.zh: 庚子，次阿敦濼，以養子涅裏思附諸弟叛，以鬼箭射殺之。
units.en: On gengzi day, at Adun Marsh, his adopted son Nielisi, who had sided with the younger brothers in rebellion, was shot to death with ghost-arrows.
units.literal: On gengzi day, halting at Adun Marsh, because the adopted son Nielisi had joined the younger brothers in rebellion, he was shot to death with ghost-arrows.

units.zh: 其餘黨六千，各以輕重論刑。
units.en: The remaining six thousand rebels were each sentenced according to the gravity of his offense.
units.literal: The remaining six thousand partisans were each sentenced according to the gravity of their crimes.

units.zh: 於厥掠生口者三十餘人，亦俾贖其罪，放歸本部。
units.en: More than thirty men of the Yuqie who had seized captives were likewise allowed to redeem their offenses and were sent back to their own departments.
units.literal: More than thirty men of the Yuqie who had seized captives were also allowed to redeem their crimes and were released to their native departments.

units.zh: 至石嶺西，詔收回軍乏食所棄兵仗，召北府兵驗而還之。
units.en: West of Stone Ridge he ordered the recovery of arms cast aside for lack of food on the return march, had northern-office troops verify them, and returned them to their owners.
units.literal: Reaching west of Stone Ridge, he ordered the recovery of weapons abandoned for lack of food on the return march, summoned Northern Office troops to verify them, and returned them.

units.zh: 以夷離涅裏袞附諸弟為叛，不忍顯戮，命自投崖而死。
units.en: Because the yili Nieligun had joined his younger brothers in rebellion, the Emperor, unwilling to put him to open death, ordered him to throw himself from a cliff.
units.literal: Because the yili Nieligun had joined the younger brothers in rebellion, unwilling to execute him openly, he ordered him to throw himself from a cliff and die.

units.zh: 秋八月己卯，幸龍眉宮，逆黨二十九人，以其妻女賜有功將校，所掠珍寶、孳畜還主；
units.en: On jimao day in the eighth autumn month he visited Longmei Palace. Twenty-nine rebels had their wives and daughters given to meritorious officers, while the precious goods and livestock they had plundered were returned to their owners;
units.literal: On jimao day in the eighth month of autumn, visiting Longmei Palace, twenty-nine rebels—their wives and daughters were given to meritorious officers; precious goods and livestock they had plundered were returned to their owners;

units.zh: 亡其本物者，命責償其家；
units.en: where the original property could not be found, the offenders' households were ordered to make restitution;
units.literal: those who had lost their original goods were ordered to be compensated from the offenders' households;

units.zh: 不能償者，賜以其部曲。
units.en: and where restitution was impossible, the victims were granted the offenders' retainers.
units.literal: those unable to compensate were granted the offenders' retainers.

units.zh: 九月壬戌，上發自西樓。
units.en: On renxu day in the ninth month the Emperor set out from Xilou.
units.literal: On renxu day in the ninth month, the Emperor set out from Xilou.

units.zh: 冬十月庚午。
units.en: In the tenth winter month, on gengwu day.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on gengwu day.

units.zh: 駐赤崖。
units.en: He encamped at Red Cliff.
units.literal: He encamped at Red Cliff.

units.zh: 戊寅，和州回鶻來貢。
units.en: On wuyin day the Uighurs of Hezhou came to offer tribute.
units.literal: On wuyin day, the Uighurs of Hezhou came to offer tribute.

units.zh: 癸未，乙室府人迪裏古、迷骨離部人特裏以從逆誅。
units.en: On guiwei day Diligu of Yishifu and Teri of the Miguli department were put to death for joining the rebellion.
units.literal: On guiwei day, Diligu of Yishifu and Teri of the Miguli Department were executed for joining the rebellion.

units.zh: 詔群臣分決滯訟，以韓知古錄其事，只裏姑掌捕亡。
units.en: He ordered the ministers to decide stalled lawsuits in turn; Han Zhigu was to record the proceedings, and Zhiligu was put in charge of pursuing fugitives.
units.literal: An edict ordered the ministers to decide stalled lawsuits separately; Han Zhigu was to record the cases, and Zhiligu was to oversee the pursuit of fugitives.

units.zh: 十一月，祠木葉山。
units.en: In the eleventh month he sacrificed at Mount Muye.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.

units.zh: 還次昭烏山，省風俗，見高年，議朝政，定吉凶儀。
units.en: On the return he halted at Zhaowu Mountain, reviewed local customs, received the elderly, discussed affairs of state, and settled the rites for auspicious and inauspicious occasions.
units.literal: Returning, he halted at Zhaowu Mountain, inspected local customs, received the aged, discussed court affairs, and fixed auspicious and inauspicious rites.

units.zh: 十二月戊子，燔柴於蓮花濼。
units.en: On wuzi day in the twelfth month he performed the firewood-burning rite at Lotus Marsh.
units.literal: On wuzi day in the twelfth month, he burned firewood at Lotus Marsh.

units.zh: 八年春正月甲辰，以曷魯為迭剌部夷離，忽烈為惕隱。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the eighth year, on jiachen day, Helu was appointed yili of the Diela department and Hulie was made tiyin.
units.literal: In spring of the eighth year, on jiachen day in the first month, Helu was made yili of the Diela Department, and Hulie was made tiyin.

units.zh: 於骨裏部人特離敏執逆党怖胡、亞裏只等十七人來獻，上親鞫之。
units.en: Telimin of the Yuguli department seized seventeen rebels including Buhu and Yalizhi and brought them in; the Emperor questioned them in person.
units.literal: Telimin of the Yuguli Department seized seventeen rebels including Buhu and Yalizhi and presented them; the Emperor personally interrogated them.

units.zh: 辭多連宗室及有脅從者，乃杖殺首惡怖胡，餘並原釋。
units.en: Their testimony implicated many members of the imperial clan as well as those who had been coerced; the Emperor had the ringleader Buhu beaten to death and pardoned the rest.
units.literal: Their testimony implicated many in the imperial clan and those who had been coerced; thereupon the chief culprit Buhu was beaten to death, and the rest were all pardoned and released.

units.zh: 於越率懶之子化哥屢蓄奸謀，上每優容之，而反覆不悛，召父老群臣正其罪，並其子戮之，分其財以給衛士。
units.en: Huage, son of the yuyue Shuilai, had repeatedly plotted treachery; the Emperor had repeatedly shown him leniency, yet he remained unrepentant and fickle. He summoned the elders and ministers to judge his crime, executed him together with his son, and divided his property among the guards.
units.literal: Huage, son of the yuyue Shuilai, repeatedly harbored treacherous designs; the Emperor each time treated him leniently, yet he was changeable and would not repent; he summoned the elders and ministers to fix his crime, executed him together with his son, and divided his property to give to the guards.

units.zh: 有司所鞫逆黨三百餘人，獄既具，上以人命至重，死不復生，賜宴一日，隨其平生之好，使為之。
units.en: Once the officials had finished interrogating more than three hundred rebels and the cases were complete, the Emperor, reflecting that human life is supremely precious and that the dead do not return, granted them a feast for one day and let each indulge his lifelong pleasures.
units.literal: More than three hundred rebels interrogated by the officials—once the cases were complete, because human life is supremely weighty and the dead do not return to life, he granted them a feast for one day and let each do according to his lifelong pleasures.

units.zh: 酒酣，或歌、或舞、或戲射、角，各極其意。
units.en: When the wine had done its work, some sang, some danced, some sported at archery or wrestling, each to the full of his heart's desire.
units.literal: When the wine was deep, some sang, some danced, some sported at shooting or wrestling, each to the full of his desire.

units.zh: 明日，乃以輕重論刑。
units.en: The next day he passed sentence on each according to the gravity of his crime.
units.literal: The next day, sentences were passed according to the gravity of the crimes.

units.zh: 首惡剌葛，其次迭剌哥，上猶弟之，不忍置法，杖而釋之。
units.en: The chief culprit was Cige, followed by Diela; the Emperor still regarded them as younger brothers, could not bring himself to apply the full penalty of the law, beat them, and released them.
units.literal: The chief culprit was Cige, followed by Diela; the Emperor still treated them as younger brothers, unwilling to apply the law, and after beating them released them.

units.zh: 以寅底石、安端性本庸弱，為剌葛所使，皆釋其罪。
units.en: Because Yindishi and Anduan were by nature weak and had been used by Cige, he pardoned them both.
units.literal: Because Yindishi and Anduan were by nature mediocre and weak and had been used by Cige, their crimes were all pardoned.

units.zh: 前于越赫底裏子解裏、剌葛妻轄剌已實預逆謀，命皆絞殺之。
units.en: Jieli, son of the former yuyue Hedili, and Cige's wife Xiachi had in fact taken part in the plot; he ordered them all strangled.
units.literal: The former yuyue Hedili's son Jieli and Cige's wife Xiachi had in fact taken part in the treacherous plot; he ordered them all strangled.

units.zh: 寅底石妻涅離脅從，安端妻粘睦姑嘗有忠告，並免。
units.en: Yindishi's wife Nieli had been coerced, and Anduan's wife Zhanmugu had once given loyal counsel; both were spared.
units.literal: Yindishi's wife Nieli had been coerced, and Anduan's wife Zhanmugu had once offered loyal counsel; both were pardoned.

units.zh: 因謂左右曰：「諸弟性雖敏黠，而蓄奸稔惡。
units.en: He then said to those around him, "My younger brothers, though clever by nature, have long harbored treachery and wickedness.
units.literal: Thereupon he said to those beside him: "My younger brothers, though clever by nature, have long stored up treachery and wickedness.

units.zh: 嘗自矜有出人之智，安忍凶狠，溪壑可塞而貪黷無厭。
units.en: They once boasted of intelligence above other men's, were pitiless and fierce, and though ravines and gullies may be filled, their greed knew no limit.
units.literal: They once prided themselves on intelligence surpassing others', were cruel and fierce without restraint, and though ravines and gullies can be filled, their greed and corruption knew no satiety.

units.zh: 求人之失，雖小而可恕，謂重如泰山；
units.en: When they sought out others' faults, though small and pardonable, they treated them as weighty as Mount Tai;
units.literal: Seeking others' faults, though small and pardonable, they called as weighty as Mount Tai;

units.zh: 身行不義，雖入大惡，謂輕於鴻毛。
units.en: yet their own unrighteous conduct, though it reached great evil, they treated as lighter than a goose feather.
units.literal: their own unrighteous conduct, though entering great evil, they called lighter than a goose feather.

units.zh: 昵比群小，謀及婦人，同惡相濟，以危國祚。
units.en: They kept company with petty men, plotted with women, aided one another in evil, and endangered the throne.
units.literal: Drawing close to petty men, plotting with women, aiding one another in evil, they endangered the imperial fortune.

units.zh: 雖欲不敗，其可得乎？
units.en: Even if they wished not to be ruined, how could they have succeeded?
units.literal: Though wishing not to be defeated, how could they succeed?

units.zh: 北宰相實魯妻餘盧睹姑於國至親，一旦負朕，從於叛逆，未置之法而病死。
units.en: The northern chancellor Shilu's wife Yuludu was among the closest kin in the realm; in a single day she betrayed me and joined the rebels; before the law could touch her she died of illness.
units.literal: The Northern Chancellor Shilu's wife Yuludu was among the closest kin in the state; in a single day she betrayed me and followed the rebels; before the law could be applied she died of illness.

units.zh: 此天誅也。
units.en: That was Heaven's punishment.
units.literal: This was Heaven's punishment.

units.zh: 解裏自幼與朕常同寢食，眷遇之厚，冠於宗屬，亦與其父背大恩而從不軌，茲可恕乎！」
units.en: Jieli from childhood shared my bed and board; the favor shown him surpassed all in the clan, yet he too, like his father, turned his back on great kindness and followed the unlawful path—how can that be forgiven!"
units.literal: Jieli from childhood constantly shared sleeping and eating with me; the favor shown him surpassed all in the clan; he also, like his father, turned his back on great kindness and followed the unlawful path—how can this be pardoned!"

units.zh: 秋七月丙申朔，有司上諸帳族與謀逆者三百餘人罪狀，皆棄市。
units.en: On the bingshen new moon in the seventh autumn month the officials presented the charges against more than three hundred clansmen who had plotted rebellion; all were executed in the marketplace.
units.literal: On the bingshen new moon in the seventh month of autumn, the officials presented the charges against more than three hundred clansmen who had plotted rebellion; all were executed in the marketplace.

units.zh: 上歎曰：「致人於死，豈朕所欲。
units.en: The Emperor sighed and said, "To bring men to death is hardly what I desire.
units.literal: The Emperor sighed and said: "To bring men to death is hardly what I desire.

units.zh: 若止負朕躬，尚可容貸。
units.en: If they had wronged only my person, I could still have spared them.
units.literal: If they had only wronged my person, they could still have been spared.

units.zh: 此曹恣行不道，殘害忠良，塗炭生民，剽掠財產。
units.en: But this lot wantonly practiced injustice, ravaged the loyal and good, brought ruin on the people, and plundered property.
units.literal: This lot wantonly practiced the way of injustice, ravaged the loyal and good, scorched the living people, and plundered property.

units.zh: 民間昔有萬馬，今皆徒步，有國以來所未嘗有。
units.en: Among the people there were once ten thousand horses; now all go on foot—something never before seen since the founding of the state.
units.literal: Among the people there were once ten thousand horses; now all go on foot—a thing never before seen since the founding of the state.

units.zh: 實不得已而誅之。」
units.en: I had no choice but to put them to death."
units.literal: Truly there was no alternative but to execute them."

units.zh: 冬十月甲子朔，建開皇殿於明王樓基。
units.en: On the jiazi new moon in the tenth winter month Kaihuang Hall was built on the foundation of Mingwang Tower.
units.literal: On the jiazi new moon in the tenth month of winter, Kaihuang Hall was built on the foundation of Mingwang Tower.

units.zh: 九年春正月，烏古部叛，討平之。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the ninth year the Wugu department rebelled; he campaigned against them and pacified the revolt.
units.literal: In spring of the ninth year, in the first month, the Wugu Department rebelled; he campaigned and pacified them.

units.zh: 夏六月，幽州軍校齊行本舉其族及其部曲男女三千人請降，詔授檢校尚書、左僕射，賜名兀欲，給其堿食。
units.en: In the sixth summer month Qi Xingben, a military officer of Youzhou, led his clan and his retainers—three thousand men and women in all—to request surrender. An edict appointed him acting director of the Imperial Secretariat and left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, granted him the name Wuyu, and supplied them with provisions.
units.literal: In the sixth month of summer, the Youzhou military officer Qi Xingben led his clan and his retainers, men and women three thousand in all, to request surrender; an edict appointed him Acting Director of the Imperial Secretariat and Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, granted the name Wuyu, and supplied them with provisions.

units.zh: 數日亡去，幽帥周德威納之。
units.en: Within a few days he fled, and Zhou Dewei, the Youzhou commander, took him in.
units.literal: Within several days he fled; the Youzhou commander Zhou Dewei received him.

units.zh: 及詔索之，德威語不遜，乃議南征。
units.en: When an edict demanded his return, Dewei answered insolently, and the court thereupon debated a southern campaign.
units.literal: When an edict demanded his surrender, Dewei's words were insubordinate; thereupon a southern campaign was discussed.

units.zh: 冬十月戊申，鉤魚于鴨淥江。
units.en: On wushen day in the tenth winter month he went hook-fishing on the Yalu River.
units.literal: On wushen day in the tenth month of winter, he fished with hook at the Yalu River.

units.zh: 新羅遣使貢方物，高麗遣使進寶劍，吳越王錢遣滕彥休來貢。
units.en: Silla sent envoys with local products; Goryeo sent envoys with a precious sword; and Qian, King of Wuyue, sent Teng Yanxiu with tribute.
units.literal: Silla sent envoys offering local products; Goryeo sent envoys presenting a precious sword; Qian, King of Wuyue, sent Teng Yanxiu to offer tribute.

units.zh: 是歲，君基太一神數見，詔圖其像。
units.en: That year the Lord Foundation Great Unity Spirit appeared repeatedly, and an edict ordered his image painted.
units.literal: That year the Lord Foundation Great Unity Spirit appeared repeatedly; an edict ordered his image painted.

units.zh: 神冊元年春二月丙戌朔，上在龍化州，迭烈部夷離堇耶律曷魯等率百僚請上尊號，三表乃允。
units.en: In Shence 1, on the bingxu new moon of the second spring month, the Emperor was at Longhua Prefecture. Yelü Helu, yilijin of the Dielie department, led the hundred officials in thrice petitioning that he accept the exalted title; after the third memorial he assented.
units.literal: In the first year of Shence, on the bingxu new moon in the second month of spring, the Emperor was at Longhua Prefecture. Yelü Helu, yilijin of the Dielie Department, led the hundred officials in petitioning that he accept the exalted title; after three memorials he assented.

units.zh: 丙申，群臣及諸屬國築壇州東，上尊號曰大聖大明天皇帝，后曰應天大明地皇后。
units.en: On bingshen day the hundred ministers and subject states raised an altar east of the prefecture; he received the exalted title Great Sage and Greatly Bright Heavenly Emperor, and the empress was titled Responsive-to-Heaven, Greatly Illumined Earth Empress.
units.literal: On bingshen day, the hundred ministers and subject states built an altar east of the prefecture; he was given the exalted title Great Sage and Greatly Bright Heavenly Emperor, and the empress was titled Responsive-to-Heaven, Greatly Illumined Earth Empress.

units.zh: 大赦，建元神冊。
units.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the Shence reign era was inaugurated.
units.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign era Shence was established.

units.zh: 初，闕地為壇，得金鈴，因名其地曰金鈴岡。
units.en: When the ground was first leveled for the altar, a golden bell was found, and the place was therefore named Golden Bell Mound.
units.literal: At first, when leveling ground for the altar, a golden bell was found; the place was therefore named Golden Bell Mound.

units.zh: 壇側滿林曰冊聖林。
units.en: The dense grove beside the altar was named Investiture Sacred Grove.
units.literal: The dense grove beside the altar was named Investiture Sacred Grove.

units.zh: 三月丙辰，以迭烈部夷離堇曷魯為阿廬朵里于越，百僚進秩、頒賚有差，賜酺三日。
units.en: On bingchen day in the third month Helu, yilijin of the Dielie department, was made yuyue of Aludoli; the hundred officials received promotions and gifts in varying measure, and a three-day feast was granted.
units.literal: On bingchen day in the third month, Helu, yilijin of the Dielie Department, was made yuyue of Aludoli; the hundred officials received promotions and gifts in varying measure, and a three-day feast was granted.

units.zh: 立子倍為皇太子。
units.en: His son Bei was named crown prince.
units.literal: His son Bei was established as Crown Prince.

units.zh: 夏四月乙酉朔，晉幽州節度使盧國用來降，<八>以為幽州兵馬留後。
units.en: On the yiyou new moon in the fourth summer month Lu Guoyong, Jin's military governor of Youzhou, came to surrender; <8> he was appointed acting commander of Youzhou troops and horses.
units.literal: On the yiyou new moon in the fourth month of summer, Lu Guoyong, military governor of Youzhou for Jin, came to surrender; <8> he was made acting commander of Youzhou troops and horses.

units.zh: 甲辰，梁遣郎公遠來賀。
units.en: On jiachen day Liang sent Lang Gongyuan with congratulations.
units.literal: On jiachen day, Liang sent Lang Gongyuan to offer congratulations.

units.zh: 六月庚寅，吳越王遣滕彥休來貢。
units.en: On gengyin day in the sixth month the King of Wuyue sent Teng Yanxiu with tribute.
units.literal: On gengyin day in the sixth month, the King of Wuyue sent Teng Yanxiu to offer tribute.

units.zh: 秋七月壬申，親征突厥、吐渾、項、小蕃、沙陀諸部，皆平之。
units.en: On renshen day in the seventh autumn month he marched in person against the Türks, Tuhun, Xiang, Lesser Fan, Shatuo, and other tribes, and pacified them all.
units.literal: On renshen day in the seventh month of autumn, he personally campaigned against the Türks, Tuhun, Xiang, Lesser Fan, Shatuo, and other departments, and pacified them all.

units.zh: 俘其酋長及其戶萬五千六百，鎧甲、兵仗、器服九十餘萬，寶貨、駝馬、牛羊不可勝算。
units.en: He took their chieftains and fifteen thousand six hundred households prisoner, together with more than nine hundred thousand suits of armor, weapons, implements, and garments, and precious goods, camels, horses, cattle, and sheep beyond reckoning.
units.literal: He captured their chieftains and their households, fifteen thousand six hundred; armor, weapons, implements, and garments more than nine hundred thousand; precious goods, camels, horses, cattle, and sheep beyond counting.

units.zh: 八月，撥朔州，擒節度使李嗣本。
units.en: In the eighth month he attacked Shuozhou and captured the military governor Li Siben.
units.literal: In the eighth month, he attacked Shuozhou and captured the military governor Li Siben.

units.zh: 勒石紀功於青塚南。
units.en: He had a stone carved to record his achievement south of Green Mound.
units.literal: He carved stone to record his achievement south of Green Mound.

units.zh: 冬十月癸未朔，乘勝而東。
units.en: On the guiwei new moon in the tenth winter month he pressed his advantage eastward.
units.literal: On the guiwei new moon in the tenth month of winter, riding the victory he marched east.

units.zh: 十一月，攻蔚、新、武、媯、儒五州，斬首萬四千七百餘級。
units.en: In the eleventh month he attacked the five prefectures of Yu, Xin, Wu, Gui, and Ru and took more than fourteen thousand seven hundred heads.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, he attacked the five prefectures of Yu, Xin, Wu, Gui, and Ru, and took more than fourteen thousand seven hundred heads.

units.zh: 自代北至河曲陰山，盡有其地。
units.en: From north of Dai to the Yin Mountains at the river bend, he held all the territory.
units.literal: From north of Dai to the Yin Mountains at the bend of the river, he possessed all the land.

units.zh: 遂改武州為歸化州，媯州為可汗州，置西南面招討司，選有功者領之。
units.en: He then renamed Wuzhou Guihua Prefecture and Guizhou Khan Prefecture, established the Southwest Pacification Office, and chose men of merit to lead it.
units.literal: Thereupon he changed Wuzhou to Guihua Prefecture and Guizhou to Khan Prefecture, established the Southwest Pacification Office, and chose men of merit to head it.

units.zh: 其圍蔚州，敵樓無故自壞，眾軍大噪乘之，不時而破。
units.en: When he besieged Yu Prefecture, the enemy towers suddenly collapsed for no apparent reason; the army raised a great shout and pressed the attack, and the city fell at once.
units.literal: When he besieged Yu Prefecture, the enemy towers for no reason collapsed of themselves; the host raised a great clamor and pressed the advantage, and the city fell without delay.

units.zh: 時梁及吳越二使皆在焉，詔引環城觀之，因賜滕彥休名曰逑呂。
units.en: Envoys from Liang and from Wu-Yue were both present; he ordered them led around the city walls to observe, and granted Teng Yanxiu the name Qiulü.
units.literal: At that time envoys from Liang and from Wu-Yue were both present; an edict led them around the city to observe, and Teng Yanxiu was granted the name Qiulü.

units.zh: 十二月，收山北八軍。
units.en: In the twelfth month he received the submission of the eight armies north of the mountains.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, he received the submission of the eight armies north of the mountains.

units.zh: 二年春二月，晉新州裨將盧文進殺節度使李存榘來降。
units.en: In the second month of spring in the second year Lu Wenjin, Jin's deputy general of Xinzhou, killed the military governor Li Cunju and came over to surrender.
units.literal: In spring of the second year, in the second month, Lu Wenjin, deputy general of Xinzhou for Jin, killed the military governor Li Cunju and came to surrender.

units.zh: 進攻其城，刺史安金全遁，以文進部將劉殷為刺史。
units.en: He advanced against the city; the prefect An Jinquan fled, and Wenjin's subordinate general Liu Yin was appointed prefect.
units.literal: Advancing to attack its city, the prefect An Jinquan fled; Wenjin's subordinate general Liu Yin was made prefect.

units.zh: 三月辛亥，攻幽州，節度使周德威以幽、并、鎮、定、魏五州之兵拒於居庸關之西，合戰於新州東，大破之，斬首三萬餘級，殺李嗣恩之子武八。
units.en: On xinhai day in the third month he attacked Youzhou. Zhou Dewei, the military governor, met him west of Juyong Pass with troops from You, Bing, Zhen, Ding, and Wei; they joined battle east of Xinzhou and were utterly broken; more than thirty thousand heads were taken, and Li Si'en's son Wuba was killed.
units.literal: On xinhai day in the third month, attacking Youzhou, the military governor Zhou Dewei with the troops of the five prefectures You, Bing, Zhen, Ding, and Wei resisted west of Juyong Pass; joining battle east of Xinzhou, he was utterly defeated; more than thirty thousand heads were taken, and Li Si'en's son Wuba was killed.

units.zh: <九>以后弟阿骨只為統軍，實魯為先鋒，東出關略燕、趙，不遇敵而還。
units.en: <9> The empress's younger brother Aguzhi was made commander-in-chief with Shilu as vanguard; marching east out of the pass he raided Yan and Zhao, met no enemy, and returned.
units.literal: <9> The Empress's younger brother Aguzhi was made commander-in-chief and Shilu vanguard; marching east out of the pass he raided Yan and Zhao, met no enemy, and returned.

units.zh: 己未，於骨裏叛，命室魯以兵討之。
units.en: On jiwei day the Yuguli rebelled, and he ordered Shilu to campaign against them.
units.literal: On jiwei day, the Yuguli rebelled; he ordered Shilu to campaign against them with troops.

units.zh: 夏四月壬午，圍幽州，不克。
units.en: On renwu day in the fourth summer month he besieged Youzhou but could not take it.
units.literal: On renwu day in the fourth month of summer, he besieged Youzhou but could not take it.

units.zh: 六月乙巳，望城中有氣如煙火狀，上曰：「未可攻也。」
units.en: On yisi day in the sixth month, looking at the city he saw vapor like smoke and fire; the Emperor said, "It cannot yet be attacked."
units.literal: On yisi day in the sixth month, gazing at the city he saw vapor like smoke and fire; the Emperor said: "It cannot yet be attacked."

units.zh: 以大暑霖潦，班師。
units.en: Because of the great heat and torrential rains, he withdrew the army.
units.literal: Because of the great heat and torrential rains, the army withdrew.

units.zh: 留曷魯、盧國用守之。
units.en: He left Helu and Lu Guoyong to hold it.
units.literal: He left Helu and Lu Guoyong to defend it.

units.zh: 剌葛與其子賽保裏叛入幽州。
units.en: Cige and his son Saibaoli rebelled and fled into Youzhou.
units.literal: Cige and his son Saibaoli rebelled and entered Youzhou.

units.zh: 秋八月，李存遣李嗣源等救幽州，曷魯等以兵少而還。
units.en: In the eighth autumn month Li Cunxu sent Li Siyuan and others to relieve Youzhou; Helu and the others, finding their forces too few, withdrew.
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, Li Cunxu sent Li Siyuan and others to relieve Youzhou; Helu and the others, finding their troops few, withdrew.

units.zh: 三年春正月丙申，以皇弟安端為大內惕隱，命攻雲州及西南諸部。
units.en: On bingshen day in the first month of spring in the third year his younger brother Anduan was made grand interior tiyin and ordered to attack Yunzhou and the southwestern tribes.
units.literal: On bingshen day in the first month of spring in the third year, his younger brother Anduan was made grand interior tiyin and ordered to attack Yunzhou and the southwestern departments.

units.zh: 二月，達旦國來聘。
units.en: In the second month the state of Dadan sent envoys on a friendly mission.
units.literal: In the second month, the state of Dadan sent envoys on a friendly mission.

units.zh: 癸亥，城皇都，以禮部尚書康默記充版築使。
units.en: On guihai day he walled the imperial capital and appointed Kang Mojie, Minister of Rites, commissioner of construction.
units.literal: On guihai day, the imperial capital was walled; Kang Mojie, Minister of Rites, was made commissioner of construction.

units.zh: 梁遣使來聘。
units.en: Liang sent envoys on a friendly mission.
units.literal: Liang sent envoys on a friendly mission.

units.zh: 晉、吳越、渤海、高麗、回鶻、阻卜、項及幽、鎮、定、魏、潞等州各遣使來貢。
units.en: Jin, Wu-Yue, Bohai, Goryeo, the Uighurs, Zubu, Xiang, and the prefectures of You, Zhen, Ding, Wei, Lu, and others each sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Jin, Wu-Yue, Bohai, Goryeo, the Uighurs, Zubu, Xiang, and the prefectures You, Zhen, Ding, Wei, Lu, and others each sent envoys to offer tribute.

units.zh: 夏四月乙巳，皇弟迭烈哥謀叛，事覺，知有罪當誅，預為營壙，而諸戚請免。
units.en: On yisi day in the fourth summer month his younger brother Dielige plotted rebellion; when the plot was discovered, knowing he deserved death, he had a grave prepared in advance, while his kinsmen all pleaded for mercy.
units.literal: On yisi day in the fourth month of summer, the younger brother Dielige plotted rebellion; when the affair was discovered, knowing he deserved execution, he beforehand prepared a grave mound, while the kinsmen all pleaded for pardon.

units.zh: 上素惡其弟寅底石妻涅裏袞，乃曰：「涅裏袞能代其死，則從。」
units.en: The Emperor had long hated his younger brother Yindishi's wife Nieligun; he therefore said, "If Nieligun will die in his place, I will consent."
units.literal: The Emperor had long hated his younger brother Yindishi's wife Nieligun; he therefore said: "If Nieligun can die in his place, then I will consent."

units.zh: 涅裏袞自縊壙中，並以奴女古、叛人曷魯只生瘞其中。
units.en: Nieligun hanged herself in the mound, and together with the slave Nügu and the rebel Heluzhi was buried alive in it.
units.literal: Nieligun hanged herself in the mound, and together with the slave Nügu and the rebel Heluzhi was buried alive therein.

units.zh: 遂赦迭烈哥。
units.en: Dielige was then pardoned.
units.literal: Thereupon Dielige was pardoned.

units.zh: 五月乙亥，詔建孔子廟、佛寺、道觀。
units.en: On yihai day in the fifth month he ordered temples to Confucius, Buddhist monasteries, and Daoist abbeys built.
units.literal: On yihai day in the fifth month, an edict ordered the building of a temple to Confucius, Buddhist monasteries, and Daoist abbeys.

units.zh: 秋七月乙酉，于越曷魯薨，上震悼久之，輟朝三日，贈賻有加。
units.en: On yiyou day in the seventh autumn month yuyue Helu died. The Emperor was deeply shaken with grief, suspended court for three days, and granted augmented funeral gifts.
units.literal: On yiyou day in the seventh month of autumn, yuyue Helu died. The Emperor was deeply shaken with grief, suspended court for three days, and granted augmented funeral gifts.

units.zh: 冬十二月庚子朔，幸遼陽故城。
units.en: On the gengzi new moon of the twelfth winter month he visited the old city of Liaoyang.
units.literal: On the gengzi new moon in the twelfth month of winter, he visited the old city of Liaoyang.

units.zh: 辛丑，北府宰相蕭敵魯薨。
units.en: On xinchou day Northern Chancellor Xiao Dilu died.
units.literal: On xinchou day, Northern Chancellor Xiao Dilu died.

units.zh: 戊午，以于越曷魯弟汙里軫為迭烈部夷離堇，蕭阿古只為北府宰相。
units.en: On wuwu day Wulizhen, younger brother of yuyue Helu, was made yilijin of the Dielie department, and Xiao Aguzhi was made Northern Chancellor.
units.literal: On wuwu day, Wulizhen, younger brother of yuyue Helu, was made yilijin of the Dielie Department, and Xiao Aguzhi was made Northern Chancellor.

units.zh: 甲子，皇孫隈欲生。
units.en: On jiazi day the imperial grandson Weiyu was born.
units.literal: On jiazi day, the imperial grandson Weiyu was born.
